data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for on‑device OCR using Tesseract and Apple Vision.
data.what_it_does: Provides OCR capabilities on Android, iOS, macOS, Linux and Web by wrapping Tesseract 4 and Apple Vision. Allows configuration of language, engine mode and page segmentation via OCRConfig.
use_when: You need offline text extraction from images across multiple platforms
You require support for many languages and custom traineddata assets
You want a single API that works on mobile, desktop and web
avoid_when: You need real‑time barcode/QR scanning (use a scanner package)
You prefer a pure Dart solution without native dependencies
strengths: Handles asset loading and native lifecycle robustly
weaknesses: Requires native setup and traineddata assets
Large asset size for multiple languages
No built‑in UI widgets, only OCR engine
data.setup_notes: Add traineddata files to assets, declare them in pubspec.yaml, ensure iOS uses Swift Package Manager or custom CocoaPods, Android needs no extra permissions but includes native libraries

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides fast barcode/QR scanning and basic OCR with less native setup

alternatives.name: google_mlkit_barcode_scanning
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers on‑device OCR via ML Kit with simpler integration for Android/iOS
